newsitem.title: CANADA: Forex trade association admits 3 new members.
newsitem.headline: Forex trade association admits 3 new members.

text.p: The national foreign exchange associations of Slovenia, Slovakia and Kenya have been admitted as full members of the Association Cambiste Internationale - The Financial Markets Association, senior ACI officials said Thursday.
Speaking after the ACI council met in Toronto for its 39th annual gathering, honorary president David Clark said the admission of these countries was a sign of the growing maturity of their markets.
"This represents yet another landmark for us and there are now 57 full national members," Clark told reporters.
Clark said Slovenia and Slovakia were two of the last remaining former-Warsaw Pact countries to join ACI while Kenya is the latest in a growing list of African countries in the association.
While there are some individual ACI members in Russia, there is still no national forex association there because of local legal problems.
The ACI, which has about 24,000 individual members worldwide, said it expects to admit Jordan, Zimbabwe and Malta next year.
